screening_decisions.reason: Meets criteria: double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of aminophylline (theophylline analogue) in patients with acute ischaemic stroke; treatment administered in the acute hospital phase (bolus + 3-day infusion), consistent with initiation within one week.

Meets criteria: double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of intravenous aminophylline in 79 patients with acute cerebral infarction; drug administered in the acute phase with immediate post-injection assessment, consistent with initiation within one week.
Design does not meet criteria: open-label, single-arm dose-escalation safety study (not randomized or placebo-controlled).
Population/design not aligned with criteria: study on cerebral metabolism with mixed subjects; not limited to acute ischaemic stroke and randomization vs placebo/control not established.
Timing does not meet criteria: randomized cross-over physiological study in patients recovering from stroke; intervention not initiated within one week of stroke onset.
Timing does not meet criteria: randomized cross-over physiological study in patients recovering from acute ischaemic stroke; intervention not initiated within one week.
Design/population do not meet criteria: non-randomized infusion study on cerebral blood flow; stroke population (acute ischaemic) not established; no placebo/control group.
Non-human (animal) study; not a randomized trial in humans with acute ischaemic stroke.
Non-human (animal) study; not a randomized trial in humans with acute ischaemic stroke.
Design does not meet criteria: lacks randomized controlled trial design and is not specific to an acute ischaemic stroke population within one week.
